name: Phong Shading with Volume Rendering
definition: A volume rendering technique that enhances the standard composite shader by applying Phong lighting (diffuse and specular) to the volume samples based on computed surface normals (gradients).
summary: Phong Shading with Volume Rendering enhances direct volume ray casting by applying Phong illumination models to volume samples, adding surface-like shading cues to volumetric data.
